'''''Ionopsidium acaule''''' ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]: {{lang|pt|cocleária-menor}}) is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the crucifer family [[Brassicaceae]], [[endemic]] to coastal [[Portugal]], specifically from [[Nazaré, Portugal|Nazaré]] to [[Sagres (Vila do Bispo)|Sagres]]. It inhabits wet sandy substrates, in clearings of [[juniper]]s, pine forests and other xerophytic scrub. Sometimes semi-ruderal on roadsides. More rarely, on calcareous or basaltic-derived soils.<ref name="iucn status 19 November 2021" />
